articles.title: A 3,010-Pound Scoop and a $6,696 Gelato: Ice Cream's Wildest Records
articles.summary: National Ice Cream Month brings bizarre records: a 3,010-pound scoop carved by snow sculptors and a $6,696 gelato with gold leaf. Plus, your flavor choice might reveal your personality, according to a neurologist.

articles.title: Saved by the Tape: Muchova Survives Match Point in Wimbledon Epic Against Gauff
articles.summary: In a dramatic Wimbledon semifinal, Karolina Muchova saved a match point and won a 12-10 tiebreak against Coco Gauff. The 2-hour-35-minute battle ended with Muchova in tears, setting up an all-Czech final.

articles.title: Cosmic Echoes Reveal Milky Way Is Larger, Heavier, and Surprisingly Lopsided
articles.summary: By analyzing X-ray echoes from gamma-ray bursts, astronomers discovered two spiral arms are 10% farther out than expected. This suggests our galaxy is more massive and asymmetrical—like a lopsided snail shell.
